conversation_approved_browse_families.heading: Separate source institute grouping from the celebration's rite, Missal, ecclesial profile and source confidence
map_first_principles: First keep every accepted physical venue findable with name, pin, source URL, and source-reported community label
Community labels drive provisional institute grouping, not public canonical or Una Cum approval
Use separate advanced dimensions for una cum, ecclesial position, exact rite and Missal, Mass type, verifiable schedule, canonical status, and source maturity
A particular venue can host distinct rites and priests; never force one ecclesial profile onto every Mass there
Sedevacantist and sedeprivationist cases need explicit authority-grounded classification; do not present as ordinary diocesan Mass candidates
Distinct institutes may coexist at one building; site/house/office/host building is not interchangeable
